records.label: spacr.embeddings.embed_array#4
records.source: a callable taking ``(n, height, width, 3)`` float32 in [0, 1] and returning ``(n, dims)``. An encoder with an ``in_channels`` attribute takes that many planes instead, and one whose ``in_channels`` is ``None`` takes any number: each channel alone under the per-channel policy, every encoded channel in one pass under the projection policy. Injected by the tests so the wiring can be exercised without downloading a backbone; production callers leave it ``None``.

Injected by the tests so the wiring can be exercised without downloading a backbone; production callers leave it ``None``.
records.translation: un objeto invocable que recibe ``(n, height, width, 3)`` en float32 dentro de [0, 1] y devuelve ``(n, dims)``. records.label: spacr.plugins#3
records.source: Plugins and assay recipes can also be installed from a catalogue, a JSON file listing each entry's version, author and licence. A catalogue plugin is installed into its own folder under ``~/.spacr/plugins`` (or ``SPACR_PLUGIN_HOME``), together with the libraries it asks for, so it never replaces or upgrades a package spaCR itself uses; it is discovered like any other plugin until it is uninstalled.
records.context: Plugins and assay recipes can also be installed from a catalogue, a JSON file listing each entry's version, author and licence. A catalogue plugin is installed into its own folder under ``~/.spacr/plugins`` (or ``SPACR_PLUGIN_HOME``), together with the libraries it asks for, so it never replaces or upgrades a package spaCR itself uses; it is discovered like any other plugin until it is uninstalled.
records.translation: Los complementos y las recetas de ensayos también pueden instalarse desde un catálogo, un archivo JSON que enumera la versión, el autor y la licencia de cada entrada. Un complemento del catálogo se instala en su propia carpeta bajo ``~/.spacr/plugins`` (o ``SPACR_PLUGIN_HOME``), junto con las bibliotecas que solicita, por lo que nunca sustituye ni actualiza un paquete que use spaCR; se detecta como cualquier otro complemento hasta que se desinstala.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.psf_pipeline#3
records.source: SPECTRAL UNMIXING COMES FIRST. With ``unmix`` on, a bleed-through matrix is estimated from the single-stain control wells ``unmix_controls`` names and every raw field is unmixed across all its channels before illumination correction, the PSF and the chain; the matrix joins the same record. Measure estimates its own over the measured channels and unmixes each field before its preprocessing hooks, recording the matrix in the saved run settings and ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.context: Spectral unmixing comes first. With ``unmix`` on, a bleed-through matrix is estimated from the single-stain control microplate sample positions ``unmix_controls`` names and every raw microscope field of view is unmixed across all its image data channels before illumination correction, the PSF and the chain; the matrix joins the same record. Measure estimates its own over the measured image data channels and unmixes each microscope field of view before its preprocessing hooks, recording the matrix in the saved processing-session settings and ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.translation: LA SEPARACIÓN ESPECTRAL SE REALIZA PRIMERO. Con ``unmix`` activado, se estima una matriz de contaminación entre canales a partir de los pocillos de control con tinción única indicados por ``unmix_controls`` y se separan todos los canales de cada campo sin procesar antes de la corrección de iluminación, la PSF y la cadena; la matriz se añade al mismo registro. Measure estima su propia matriz sobre los canales medidos y separa cada campo antes de sus operaciones de preprocesamiento, registrando la matriz en los ajustes de ejecución guardados y en ``measurements/bleed_through.json``.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

Host–Pathogen contains two real THP-1 RNF213 fields, prepared host/nucleus/vacuole masks and fresh measurements of those fields. Replication and Recruitment contain slices of measured screens. records.label: spacr.qt.model_install.SpotDetectorCombo#1
records.source: spaCR's own detector is first, the default and always usable. SpotNet and Spotiflow are listed whether or not they can run; when one's environment (or SpotNet's DeepCell token) is missing its row is disabled and its tooltip says which. SpotNet's tooltip states its non-commercial licence either way, because this box is where a person chooses it. A saved Spotiflow choice is kept even while its row is disabled or hidden, so the run receives it and says why it cannot run rather than detecting with another detector.
